newsitem.title: USA: Nabisco sues Warner-Lambert on trademark.
newsitem.headline: Nabisco sues Warner-Lambert on trademark.

text.p: Nabisco Holdings Corp sued Warner-Lambert Co for alleged infringement of Nabisco's trademark on a chewing gum brand name, said Nabisco's complaint filed in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York.

In its complaint, Nabisco said it has sold "Ice Breakers" gum since November 1995 and its total sales since the gum's introduction have exceeded $39 million. Nabisco said Warner-Lambert recently began selling a chewing gum under the trademark "Ice."

Nabisco alleged that Warner-Lambert's sale of a gum with the brand name "Ice" is likely to cause confusion, mistake or deception to the public and to cause the public to believe that Warner-Lambert's products are in fact Nabisco's products.

Nabisco is seeking an injunction against Warner-Lambert to prevent Warner-Lambert from distributing any gum products bearing the brand name "Ice" and an accounting of Warner-Lambert's profits arising from "Ice" sales.
